design_rationale:
WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The caller asks one flat thing - pay the next instalment on a package holiday - and never names a figure, a rule or a second piece of work. Arriving at 9918.98 forces the agent to (a) discover from the published balance rule that the balance is worked out only after the ledger carries a surcharge line answering every surcharge the operator has notified, (b) find in the ledger an operator surcharge notice of 2026-09-04 that nothing answers, (c) work out the surcharge itself (2133.61) from a notice-selection rule, a club concession, a party head basis and a loyalty rate, (d) post it, and only then (e) reconcile eleven ledger lines plus a club record into the balance and hand the payment to the traveller to make herself. Nothing here is tool-choice difficulty: both tools are unambiguous once their problems are identified. All of the difficulty is in reading the policy, reconciling history and getting the arithmetic right at the right moment.

SCOPE LEDGER (Principle C). Nothing was occupied before this task; it is task 0 of 2. This task claims bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing (target price_package_surcharge_8a2d0e07) and bundle_ext_balance_settlement (target settle_package_balance_32304520), i.e. the operator-surcharge pricing core and the balance/payment-schedule core. Left free for task 1, which draw_counts.py also gives a tree of two problems: the party-pricing core (single occupancy supplements, re-pricing the party actually travelling) and the amendment core (bundle_amendment / bundle_party_amend), with their own tools. No base policy is exhausted: bundle_cancellation, bundle_credit, bundle_refund_settlement, bundle_travel_period and bundle_agg_multi_holding are untouched by either task, so the difficulty is not filled up by task 0.

STEP 0 DRAW (verbatim output of scripts/draw_counts.py env/online_travel_agency/tasks/vacation_packages_desk --tasks 2):
{"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}
{"task": 1, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}
Task 0 therefore has exactly one prerequisite problem and two computations carrying 4 and 5 factors. bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing took the 4 (notice_selection_rule, club_tier_rate_concession, party_head_basis, frequent_traveller_loyalty_rate); bundle_ext_balance_settlement took the 5 (club_package_discount, promotional_deposit_shortfall, agency_service_fee_recovery, instalment_split_method, currency_presentation_loading).

PROBLEM-TREE CARD (Principle H). Root problem: bundle_ext_balance_settlement - the problem the caller's surface request points at ("she wants to pay the next instalment on the holiday today"). One prerequisite problem: bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing.
Edge bundle_ext_balance_settlement <- bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing. kind: value_input. gate: charges_on_ledger (a real compute binding of the blocked policy). form: state. Prerequisite sentence, carried verbatim in the blocked policy's own rule: "The balance is worked out only after the package ledger carries a surcharge line answering every surcharge the operator has notified against the package." Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the balance being worked out) to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is purely a record-visible state - a kind of entry standing on the package ledger - and names no action, no performer and no tool; (3) it contains no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id; (4) its strength is exactly the edge's: "only after" is hard, and the scope is every surcharge the operator has notified, which is exactly the condition field. State form was available and is used, so no fallback_reason. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: price_package_surcharge_8a2d0e07 is the only tool in task_tools.py that creates a line of charge_category fuel_surcharge, and bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing is the only policy whose result is a surcharge priced onto the ledger. Derivation a reader performs: the sentence says a surcharge line must stand; find_bundle_ledger_entries shows a notice advising 520.00 per traveller and no line answering it; the surcharge policy's own rule says what a surcharge priced onto the ledger is and how it is worked out; therefore the one action that brings the state about is to price that surcharge - exactly one reading. Condition: "The package ledger carries a surcharge line answering every surcharge notice standing against the package." resolved_by: price_package_surcharge_8a2d0e07 (owner=agent). Root's own write is owner=user (settle_package_balance_32304520), so the tree carries the customer's own write.
Why the prerequisite is false at the opening: of the eleven seeded ledger lines, five are deposits, two are instalments, two are component discounts (third_adult_discount and child_discount) and two are operator notices; none is a charge answering the surcharge notice. Recorded row by row in prerequisite_closure.edges[0].unresolved_at_frozen_time.evidence.
Topological order: [bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing, bundle_ext_balance_settlement], which is the gold write order (actions 7 then 9). No parallel edges, so order_uniqueness is trivial and recorded as such.
Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping action 7 and replaying everything else gives charges_on_ledger -2864.00 instead of -730.39, gross_outstanding 17126.55 instead of 19260.16 and balance_due_usd 8820.17 instead of 9918.98 - and the terminal ledger loses the surcharge row. The edge bears weight.
The tool layer blocks nothing: both function bodies are a single ctx.make_id followed by a single ctx.create; neither reads a row, tests a status or returns an error. settle_package_balance_32304520 is fully callable and writes faithfully while the surcharge is still unpriced, and the only consequence is a wrong terminal hash.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject bundle_component_charge. Governing base policies: bundle_components and bundle_agg_party_pricing. bundle_components.package_live (kind state, authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlation key bundle_packages.bundle_package_id bound to the tool's bundle_package_id): the package stands at deposit_held, one of the allowed states, at frozen time - satisfied. bundle_agg_party_pricing carries no structured eligibility for this subject, so it enters as policy_scope with the party fields as evidence. No time gate on this write. Write 2, subject bundle_final_payment_charge. Governing base policies: bundle_payment_schedule and bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction. bundle_payment_schedule.price_guarantee_elapsed (kind time): anchor event "the moment the operator took the party's deposit for this package", anchor source bundle_packages.deposit_taken_at = 2026-08-12 09:41:00 America/Chicago, relation not_before, duration source variants.price_guarantee_days = 21 for the All-Inclusive Resort Package, unit calendar_days, counting rule "from the day after the deposit was taken, weekends and public holidays included", boundary inclusive so a balance taken exactly on the closing day is still inside the term. Counting: day 1 is 2026-08-13, day 21 is 2026-09-02, so the term closes on 2026-09-02 and the balance may be taken from 2026-09-03. Negative boundary case: at frozen time 2026-09-02 the correct handling is to wait. Positive boundary case: at 2026-09-03 it may be taken. Frozen time is 2026-09-16, thirteen days clear. bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction carries no structured eligibility and enters as policy_scope. Every base clause not named in an overwrite is inherited: in particular bundle_components' rule that a component is priced only while the package is live, and bundle_payment_schedule's instalment and currency-markup sentences, which the extended balance policy refines rather than replaces.

OVERWRITE. One declared override: bundle_evt_supplier_notice's clause "Several notices about the same package are not added together; the last notice standing before departure decides what is owed and what may be refused." is superseded, for the purpose of fixing the notified rate, by the extended sentence "Where the notice posted latest against the package advises no surcharge and an earlier notice standing against the package advises a surcharge above nil, the amount advised by the latest notice that did advise a surcharge is taken as the notified rate instead". Evaluated once in the same world, base gives 0.00 (the last notice standing carries no charge) and extended gives 520.00, so the divergence is real and is declared. That base clause carries no eligibility gate, so nothing is retired from the precondition ledger. The same policy declares a second override against the same base policy, retiring "A surcharge at or below the product's threshold share of the package price must be paid, and a surcharge above it entitles the party to cancel with nothing withheld or to accept a comparable alternative.": base gives the party a right to refuse a surcharge above the threshold where this policy instead holds the figure priced at the threshold share, and the two are no longer left standing together. The cap does not bind on this world - 2269.80 x 0.94 = 2133.61 against a threshold share of 2291.20 - but the declaration holds wherever it would. bundle_ext_balance_settlement declares four overrides, each naming the base sentence it retires and the sentence of its own rule that takes its place. Against bundle_payment_schedule it retires "A product that allows instalments splits the balance into its own number of equal instalments falling due at equal intervals between the deposit and the final-payment date, and the last instalment is adjusted for rounding.": evaluated once on this world, base splits 27660.16 into four equal instalments of 6915.04 and, after the currency loading, reaches 7122.49, while the extended sentence divides what is still outstanding by the instalments that remain and reaches 9918.98. The two seeded instalments of 4200.00 are nowhere near 6915.04, so the readings cannot coincide here, and the divergence is now declared rather than left for a reader to meet in two places. Against bundle_booking_terms it retires "The agency service fee is charged per traveller when the deposit is taken and is never returned.", because this policy carries the fee into the balance where no fee line was ever taken and lets a tier that waives it remove it; and it retires "The deposit is the product's flat amount per traveller, or its share of the package price where the product takes a share; the two are never both taken.", because the All-Inclusive Resort Package publishes both a flat 300.00 per traveller and a 15 percent share, so the base sentence alone does not say what the standard deposit is - read as the share it gives a shortfall of 3801.00 and a balance of 11358.92, read as the flat amount it gives 1005.00 and 9918.98 - and the extended sentence now states outright that the flat amount is taken. Against bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction it retires "Where the member's tier changes between deposit and departure, the discount applied at deposit stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back.", because the expiring-tier tier of the package discount reduces the discount on account of a date that falls after the deposit; that tier is not reached on this world, the tier held expiring on 2027-02-28 after the 2026-11-20 departure, but the clause is retired wherever the rule would otherwise meet it. Every other sentence of those three base policies stands and is inherited, including the price-guarantee gate, its counting rule and the currency markup taken as each payment is taken; no eligibility gate is retired, because none of the four superseded clauses is a gate's condition sentence.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single vacation package WLPKG40271 held by this traveller; the correlation key is bundle_packages.bundle_package_id, which is the action binding of both eligibility gates and the first argument of both tools. Rows that enter the aggregates: the five deposit lines (deposit_paid, deposit_lines), the two instalments (instalments_paid_amount, instalments_paid_count), the two component discounts and, after action 7, the surcharge line (charges_on_ledger), and the two notices (latest_notice_amount, surcharge_notice_amount). Rows deliberately excluded by the filters: the notices are excluded from charges_on_ledger because they carry event_type bundle_supplier_notice, not bundle_component_charge; the component discounts are excluded from the notice reads for the same reason; and the agency-service-fee count finds nothing because no such line was ever posted, which is what puts the customer on the second tier of that factor. The traveller holds no second package, so no cross-package aggregation is possible. Nothing already settles the surcharge: no ledger line carries source_entry_id pointing at either notice.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing (4 factors, the drawn count).
1. notice_selection_rule, effect method, decides notified_rate. Ladder: (i) the latest notice advises no surcharge and an earlier notice advises above nil -> the amount advised by the latest notice that did advise a surcharge is taken; (ii) the latest notice advises no surcharge and no earlier notice advises above nil -> the notified rate is nil; (iii) otherwise -> the amount advised by the latest notice. Tier taken: (i). Evidence rows: the 2026-09-09 notice OPS-ITIN-2026-5122 at 0.00 and the 2026-09-04 notice OPS-SURCH-2026-4417 at 520.00. Baseline reading: the amount advised by the notice posted latest, 0.00; Step 5 sensitivity run gives result 0.0 against gold 2133.61. This is a method factor in the "selection rule among candidates" family: it changes which record decides the quantity, not a number inside a fixed formula.
2. club_tier_rate_concession, effect parameter, decides borne_rate, cross-difficulty club. Ladder: active membership whose tier carries a package discount and at least one package accrual in the last twelve months -> the notified rate less that tier's package discount percentage; the same membership with no package accrual in twelve months -> less that percentage taken at the dormant-member share; otherwise -> the notified rate itself. Tier taken: the first. Evidence rows: club membership (Wanderlane Gold, active, package_discount_pct 3) and the club points accruals of 2026-03-14 and 2025-11-02 whose accrual_source is bundle_booking. Baseline 520.00 -> result 2199.60.
3. party_head_basis, effect parameter, decides head_basis. Ladder: a third-adult discount line stands and children travel -> adults less the third adult, that third adult at the product's third-adult share, plus children at the product's child share; a third-adult discount line stands and no children travel -> adults less the third adult at the third-adult share; otherwise -> adults and children counted together. Tier taken: the first, giving 4.50. Evidence rows: the third_adult_discount ledger line and party_children = 1. Baseline 5 -> result 2291.20 (the product's threshold share then binds).
4. frequent_traveller_loyalty_rate, effect parameter, decides loyalty_rate, cross-difficulty club. Ladder: more than the frequent-traveller threshold of package accruals in thirty-six months with an active membership -> the loyalty concession; exactly the threshold with an active membership -> the near-threshold concession; otherwise -> the whole of it. Tier taken: the first (four accruals against a threshold of three). Evidence rows: the four bundle_booking accruals of 2026-03-14, 2025-11-02, 2024-09-30 and 2024-02-18, plus the active membership row. Baseline 1.0 -> result 2269.80.
Whole-baseline fall-back for this computation: 0.0, recorded as computations[0].baseline_result and different from gold.
Near miss planted for this computation: the 2026-09-09 itinerary notice. A careless reader takes "the last notice standing before departure decides what is owed" at face value and reads 0.00; the rule excludes it because it advises no surcharge. A second near miss: the 2025-11-02 accrual sits ten months back, inside the twelve-month window, so a reader who counts only the current calendar year still lands on the right tier, while the 2024 accruals matter only for the thirty-six-month count.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_balance_settlement (5 factors, the drawn count).
1. club_package_discount, parameter, decides club_discount_pct, cross-difficulty club. Tier taken: tier took effect 2026-01-05, on or before the deposit date 2026-08-12, and status_expiry_date 2027-02-28 falls after departure 2026-11-20 -> the tier's 3 percent. Evidence: the club membership row's variant_name, tier_effective_date and status_expiry_date. Baseline nil -> 10361.47.
2. promotional_deposit_shortfall, parameter, decides deposit_shortfall_due. Tier taken: the product allows a reduced promotional deposit and the five deposit lines total 495.00 against 300.00 standard for each of them -> 1005.00. Evidence: the five deposit lines. Baseline nil -> 9401.41.
3. agency_service_fee_recovery, parameter, decides service_fee_due, cross-difficulty club. Tier taken: no agency service fee line stands and the gold tier does not waive the fee -> 19.95 for each of five travellers, 99.75. Evidence: the absence of an agency_service_fee line and CPARAM('club','agency_service_fee_waiver') = False. Baseline nil -> 9867.61.
4. instalment_split_method, method, decides instalment_due. Tier taken: the product allows instalments and two have been taken -> the outstanding amount divided by four less two, rounded at that step, 9630.08. Evidence: the two instalment lines. Baseline the whole outstanding amount -> 19837.96. This is a method factor in the transform family: it changes how the figure due now is derived from the outstanding amount, not a number inside it.
5. currency_presentation_loading, parameter, decides loading_rate. Tier taken: all seven payments taken so far were presented in euros and none in the operator's own currency -> 1 plus the product's 3 percent markup. Evidence: the currency_charged of the five deposits and two instalments. Baseline 1.0 -> 9630.08.
Whole-baseline fall-back: 19014.61, recorded as computations[1].baseline_result and different from gold. Near miss planted: the two instalments are posted through the web channel while the deposits came through the call centre, so a reader who filters payments by channel rather than by currency lands on the wrong loading tier; and the two operator notices are component-charge-shaped in charge_category but not in event_type, so a reader who sums by charge_category rather than event_family pulls 520.00 into charges_on_ledger.
No factor's tier is read off a stamp. The package record's amount_paid_usd (6031.00) is the only cached quantity and no rule reads it; it agrees with the ledger at the opening (495.00 of deposit plus 8400.00 of instalments less 2864.00 of component discounts is 6031.00) and is deliberately left stale after the writes, which is normal for a cached total.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The customer row is the identity anchor and supplies the two credentials the verification tool needs. The package row fixes the product (every P() parameter), the party, the quoted price, the departure date and the deposit moment (the time gate's anchor). The five deposit lines at 99.00 are what make the promotional-deposit-shortfall factor bite; delete one and the shortfall falls by 201.00 and the balance by 52.53. The two instalments put the instalment-split factor on its first tier and supply two of the payments the currency factor counts; delete them and the divisor becomes four and the balance changes. The third-adult discount line is the sole evidence for the head-basis tier; delete it and head_basis becomes 5 and the surcharge becomes 2291.20. The child discount line is consistent with the one child on the record and is part of charges_on_ledger. The 2026-09-04 surcharge notice is the whole prerequisite; the 2026-09-09 itinerary notice is the near miss that makes the notice-selection rule bite. The club membership row carries the tier, the effective date and the expiry date three factors read. The four club points accruals decide two factors across two different windows. Nothing else is seeded: replay reports closure 18 of 18 rows.

PERSONA DESIGN. Bernadette is brisk and self-aware rather than anxious: a professional who plans a year ahead, pays in instalments on purpose, and has no interest in the arithmetic. Her voice carries the six kinds of information without a template - the opening paragraph gives the person, the situation and the surface request; the second gives the locating details and the explicit cannot-answer branch for the booking reference; the third holds everything she gives only when asked (the four-part schedule, the euro presentation, the gold card, the unchanged room arrangements); the fourth fixes the authorisation boundary and her two passive reactions. She volunteers nothing about the operator's surcharge, and nothing she says is contradicted by initial_state: the four-part schedule, the two payments already made, the euro presentation and the gold tier are all readable in the seed. She never states a figure, so she cannot telegraph 2133.61 or 9918.98, and if the agent quotes a wrong number she still closes the same way - the scoring alone carries the consequence. Her last reaction answers the last gold action (the payment she makes herself) and asks for nothing beyond it.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION. Turn by turn: she gives name and mobile -> find_customers; the agent asks for one or two details on file -> date of birth and passport characters -> verify_traveller_identity; the agent looks up the package, its ledger, the club membership and the club points ledger, all with share tools and no waiting; the agent reads the balance rule, sees the prerequisite, sees the unanswered notice, works out 2133.61 and posts it; the agent then works out 9918.98, unlocks the payment tool, hands it over, and she runs it. Every question a real agent must ask has an answer in the persona - the currency, the club card, whether she can supply the reference, who presses the button - and the one she cannot answer (the booking reference) has a written branch. Nothing waits on a diagnosis, a clearing, a review or a future date: both writes are synchronous ledger lines under the single frozen_time 2026-09-16 10:20:00 America/Chicago.

TWO-WAY EQUIVALENCE (rule <-> compute). Forward: every binding that reads the world or makes a choice carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis - latest_notice_amount and surcharge_notice_amount to the notice sentences, notified_rate to the selection sentence, club_tier_package_pct and club_package_accruals_12m and borne_rate to the concession sentences, third_adult_lines and head_basis to the head-basis sentences, club_package_accruals_36m and club_active and loyalty_rate to the loyalty sentences, threshold_cap to the threshold clause and result to the closing sentence; and on the balance side club_tier_package_pct, tier_effect_lead_days, status_expiry_lead_days, club_discount_pct, discounted_price, charges_on_ledger, deposit_paid, deposit_lines, deposit_shortfall_due, service_fee_lines, club_fee_waiver, service_fee_due, instalments_paid_amount, instalments_paid_count, instalment_due, usd_payment_lines, payment_lines, loading_rate and result each to their own sentence. Reverse sweep: every load-bearing sentence of both rules is claimed - the "twelve months" and "thirty-six months" windows appear as within_months=12 and within_months=36; "stands active" appears as status='active' on the cross-category reads; "rounded to two decimal places at that step" appears as the inner RND inside instalment_due and "rounded to two decimal places" as the outer RND on result; "never less than nil" appears as MX(...,0.0); "held at no more than the product's threshold share" appears as MN(...,threshold_cap); "reduced once by the package discount applied; the discount acts on the quoted price alone and never on the ledger lines" pins the acting base of the only rate that could have been applied twice; and the order and grouping of the outstanding amount is written out in full rather than left to "in turn". No sentence of either rule is unclaimed and no filter in either compute is unquoted.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate and verify; read the package; read every ledger line; read the club membership and its points ledger. Notice from the balance rule that the balance waits on a surcharge line answering every notified surcharge; see that none stands. Work the surcharge: the latest notice carries nothing, so the rate comes from the 2026-09-04 notice at 520.00; the active gold tier with a package accrual inside twelve months takes it to 504.40; the third-adult discount line and the one child give a head basis of 4.50, so 2269.80; four package accruals in thirty-six months give a loyalty rate of 0.94, so 2133.612; the 8 percent threshold share of 28640.00 is 2291.20 and does not bite; post 2133.61 quoting OPS-SURCH-2026-4417 in EUR. Then the balance: the gold tier took effect before the deposit and expires after departure, so 3 percent off 28640.00 gives 27780.80; the component lines now total -730.39; the promotional deposit shortfall is 1005.00 and the unwaived agency service fee 99.75; less 495.00 of deposit and 8400.00 of instalments the outstanding amount is 19260.16; two of four instalments are taken so the figure due now is 9630.08; every payment so far was presented in euros so the loading is 1.03; pay 9918.98 as instalment 3 in EUR, by handing the tool to the traveller.

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN. The two computations were evaluated with the gate's own evaluator (skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py build_env/eval_compute/substitute) on the handling-time worlds - the opening world for the surcharge, and the opening world plus the surcharge write for the balance. Output: surcharge result 2133.61 with per-factor baselines 0.0, 2199.6, 2291.2, 2269.8 and whole-baseline 0.0; balance result 9918.98 with per-factor baselines 10361.47, 9401.41, 9867.61, 19837.96, 9630.08 and whole-baseline 19014.61; the prerequisite-skipped replay gives 8820.17. These are exactly the figures recorded in computations and gold. Gate runs: check_extended --task 0 EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; check_compute --task 0 COMPUTE OK (2 comps, 9 factors, 4 cross-difficulty, 13 history rows, 29 branches, 10 steps); check_solvability --task 0 SOLVABILITY OK; check_grounding --task 0 GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire --task 0 SCOPE OK; replay_tasks --task 0 reports determinism True, non-vacuous True and closure 18 of 18, with one environment-level error that is not this task's: the gate's TrackingDB has no fuzzy_find, which the blueprint's shared find_customers uses, and the same line appears on every existing scenario in this repository.

CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation -> gold call -> terminal state: bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing -> price_package_surcharge_8a2d0e07 -> computations[0].step 7, arg surcharge_amount_usd -> evaluation_criteria[7] -> one fuel_surcharge line of 2133.61 standing on the package; bundle_ext_balance_settlement -> settle_package_balance_32304520 -> computations[1].step 9, arg balance_due_usd -> evaluation_criteria[9] -> one final_payment line of 9918.98 as instalment 3. charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computation policy ids and required_documents repeats it in order. Base automatic clauses checked against the seed: the balance falling due on 2026-10-06 has not yet passed, so the non-payment cancellation clause does not fire; the price-guarantee term has run out, so the surcharge is permitted; no excursion credit is granted before departure; no voucher, payout or penalty is owed on a live package; the package is not confirmed, so no club points accrual is triggered and no cross-category write can arise from either tool.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier, and working only from what a rollout sees - the two policy documents as they will be published, the two tool schemas, the share-tool query returns and what she actually says - the same conclusion is reached: the balance rule itself states the wait, the ledger shows the unanswered notice, and both figures follow uniquely from the published ladders and the records. The one place a second reading could have arisen is which notice fixes the rate, and the overwrite declares that exclusively in prose; the second is whether the club discount acts on the ledger lines as well as the quoted price, and the rule pins the acting base explicitly. No second solution survives.

REVISIONS. (1) Symptom: the surcharge policy was first written with trigger on_request, which would have forced its discriminator's business meaning to appear verbatim in the persona and so would have made the customer hint at the prerequisite. Root cause: the trigger was classified by who benefits rather than by whether the money is owed with nobody calling. Change: trigger set to state_due, intent_source repointed at the initial_state notice row. Re-run: SOLVABILITY OK, and prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint holds. (2) Symptom: the persona named a traveller whose name collided with another desk's caller. Change: the caller was renamed throughout initial_state, the persona and the gold locator argument in one pass. Re-run: SOLVABILITY OK, GROUNDING OK.(3) Round 2, finding 0-1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED, undeclared override of the instalment-split sentence). Symptom: base bundle_payment_schedule and this policy's instalment ladder both fixed balance_due_usd, at 7122.49 and 9918.98. Root cause: overwrite was [] while the rule handled the quantity the base sentence governs differently, so the base sentence stood in full in the same published documents. Change: the base sentence is now named in bundle_ext_balance_settlement.overwrite with the extended sentence that replaces it; the OVERWRITE paragraph above was rewritten, its false assertion that nothing was contradicted removed, and the 7122.49 reading recorded. Re-run: EXTENDED OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, and the scored figure is unchanged at 9918.98 because no formula moved. (4) Round 2, finding 0-2 (SOURCE-CHAIN RED). Symptom: prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing[0].skipped_effect claimed an outstanding amount of 17640.35 on the world with the surcharge write skipped. Root cause: that figure was obtained by doubling the post-loading balance (8820.17 x 2) instead of re-running gross_outstanding on that world. Change: the figure is now 17126.55 in the closure and in the problem-tree card above, recomputed as 27780.80 - 2864.00 + 1005.00 + 99.75 - 495.00 - 8400.00 and checked against 17126.55 / 2 x 1.03 = 8820.17, which is the closure's own final figure. Re-run: SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK. (5) Round 2, finding 0-3 (observation). Two prose figures were false: the cached amount_paid_usd was quoted as 8895.00 where the record carries 6031.00, and deleting one deposit line was said to move the balance by 103.52 where a replay moves it by 52.53 (9918.98 to 9866.45). Both corrected in place; neither decides a scored value. (6) Round 2, findings 0-4, 0-6, F-8, F-9 and F-10. The world carried a final-payment line posted 2026-08-20, inside the price-guarantee term the base gate closes on 2026-09-02, and an operator surcharge notice posted 2026-08-28, also inside that term, which under the reading of base's "a surcharge may be added after booking only ... after the product's price-guarantee term has run out" that treats "added" as "notified" would make the surcharge unpayable and the balance 8820.17. user_scenario:
Bernadette Okonkwo-Hale is fifty-two, a landscape architect who has run her own small practice in Chicago since her forties and who takes exactly one long holiday a year, planned to the last detail and paid for in pieces so that it never lands on a single statement. This November she is taking her husband, her sister, her brother-in-law and her nine-year-old nephew to an all-inclusive resort on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, and she rings the Wanderlane desk on a Wednesday morning from her office, kettle going in the background, because she wants to pay the next instalment on the holiday today and get it off her mind before she flies out to a site visit on Friday.

She leads with her name and the mobile number the booking notices go to, Bernadette Okonkwo-Hale on 7050418823, and says it is the Costa Rica resort trip in November, five of them altogether. She has not got the booking reference in front of her and says so without any fuss, asking whoever she is speaking to to find it from her name instead; if she is pressed for something else held on file she gives her date of birth, 1974-03-09, and then the last four characters of her passport, 5412, and if even that is not enough she says she is at the office with nothing else on her and would rather be rung back than start guessing.

What she has no idea about is the figure. If she is asked what she was expecting to pay, she says the schedule was set up in four payments, that two of them have already gone out, and that she has never once tried to work the arithmetic out herself and would far rather be told the number than argue with it. If she is asked which currency she is billed in, she explains that everything on this booking has been presented to her in euros because the card is the one on her Milan account, and she would like this payment presented the same way, in EUR. If her club card comes up she says she has been a member for years and is on the gold tier, though she could not say what it is worth and leaves that sort of thing to the desk. If she is asked about the resort or the room arrangements she is happy to chat about them but adds that she has asked for nothing to be altered at her end.

She is quite clear about who does what. She is content for the desk to work the figure out and to do whatever the booking needs at their end, but the money leaves her own account and she will press the button herself; she says so plainly the first time anyone offers to take the payment for her. When the agent hands the payment over for her to make, she makes it there and then and reads back whatever the receipt says. Once she has heard that the payment has gone through she says that is exactly what she wanted, thanks them for being quick about it, and rings off.
